meta.description: AYV WRLD creates focused software tools that help businesses capture leads, book customers, close quotes, collect payments, and bring customers back.

common.individualNote: No bundle checkout is available yet. Available products can still be purchased individually.

home.headline: Turn everyday work into <muted>revenue.</muted>
home.productsTitle: Six focused tools. <muted>One for every job.</muted>
home.productsBody: Start with one focused app. Avyro, Velto, Rovyn, and Orvyn are available now and connect in one workspace; Nexro and Ravelo are coming soon.

together.title: One client journey. Four focused apps.
together.body: Each app works on its own. Connect them when you are ready and customer details, context, dates, and next actions move with the work.
together.step1: Capture and follow up with a lead
together.step3: Send and follow up on the quote
together.outcome: Enter details once, keep one client history, and see the full journey in the command center and shared calendar.

features.title: Everything you need. <muted>Nothing you don''t.</muted>
features.loginBody: Access every AYV product from a single account and a shared workspace. No juggling logins or stitching tools together.
features.liveBody: Create an account, tell us about your business, and start. Each tool is built to be running the same day you sign up.
features.automationsBody: Set the rules once. Follow-ups, reminders, and requests go out on their own so nothing slips through the cracks.
features.teamsBody: No enterprise overhead. Everything is designed for owners and lean teams who need results, not a manual.
features.secureBody: Your customer data stays protected with modern authentication and per-account isolation from day one.
features.pricingBody: Each available app has one clear monthly price. The AYV Automation Stack comparison shows the planned 50% value; subscriptions are purchased individually today.

how.title: Three steps. <muted>Infinite possibilities.</muted>
how.step1Body: Sign up in seconds with your email. One AYV WRLD account unlocks every tool as it launches.
how.step2Body: Tell us who you serve and how you work. We tailor each tool to your industry and workflow.
how.step3Body: Turn on the automations that fit you. Leads, bookings, quotes, and payments handle themselves.

bundle.title: Build your connected automation stack.
bundle.body: Start with any available app and add others as your workflow grows. AYV Automation Stack shows €400 catalog value and a planned price of €200.
bundle.productBody: AYV Automation Stack is displayed at 50% off the €400 catalog total, saving €200 per month. Product subscriptions are purchased individually today.
bundle.availability: AYV Automation Stack pricing is displayed for planning; there is no separate stack checkout yet.

cta.title: Start turning work into revenue.
cta.body: Create your AYV WRLD account today and be ready the moment each tool goes live.

footer.blurb: Focused software tools that turn everyday business tasks into automated revenue.

productPage.builtForOneJob: Built to do one job exceptionally well.
productPage.planBody: One clear monthly price. No setup fees, cancel anytime.
productPage.connectedOutcome: Connections reuse customer details, preserve context, update the shared calendar and command center, and never merge or delete the original records.

avyro.longDescription: Avyro captures new leads from forms, ads, DMs, or website chat and starts a personalized email or SMS follow-up so no lead goes cold. It scores leads and alerts you when one is hot.
avyro.dashboardDescription: Follow up with new leads quickly so more conversations become customers.
avyro.connectedValue: Turn a qualified Avyro lead into a Velto booking without re-entering contact details, then keep the later quote and invoice in the same client journey.

velto.longDescription: Velto lets clients book without back-and-forth messaging, then sends confirmation and reminder email or SMS, including 24 hours and 1 hour before. It can also handle reschedule requests.
velto.highlight2: Automated confirmation messages and reminders 24 hours and 1 hour before
velto.dashboardDescription: Take bookings and send reminders so fewer appointments are missed.
velto.connectedValue: Create a booking from an Avyro lead, then hand a completed appointment to Rovyn with the customer and service context already filled.

rovyn.longDescription: After a quote is sent, Rovyn follows up on a schedule, such as day 2, day 5, and day 10, until the prospect responds. Follow-up pauses once they reply.
rovyn.highlight2: Customizable follow-up timing and response tracking
rovyn.highlight3: Follow-up pauses once the client responds
rovyn.dashboardDescription: Follow up on sent quotes so more proposals turn into booked work.
rovyn.connectedValue: Build a quote from a Velto booking, keep its service context, and turn won work into an Orvyn invoice without typing the customer again.

orvyn.longDescription: Orvyn sends invoice reminders before and after the due date, follows up on late payments with a firmer tone, and tells you when an invoice is paid.
orvyn.dashboardDescription: Track unpaid invoices and schedule reminders so money arrives sooner.
orvyn.connectedValue: Create an invoice from a won Rovyn quote and retain the lead, booking, and quote context beside payment status and reminders.

nexro.longDescription: Nexro reaches inactive customers with a win-back offer or check-in, and asks happy customers for a referral with an incentive.
nexro.highlight1: Automated win-back campaigns for inactive customers
nexro.dashboardDescription: Customer reactivation and referrals are coming soon.

ravelo.longDescription: Ravelo asks for a review shortly after a job is done, sends happy clients to a public review site, and routes unhappy feedback to the business first.
ravelo.highlight2: Public review or private feedback routing
ravelo.highlight3: Links for more than one review platform
